title: Psi27D / Omega1766 geometric-control hypothesis for 3D Navier-Stokes regularity
description: Falsifiable research hypothesis: an explicitly defined geometric/topological functional on a declared manifold Sigma_1766 embedded in R^27, coupled through the Omega1766 transport-boundary-response operator, may provide a reproducible quantitative bound controlling vorticity or velocity-gradient growth in 3D incompressible Navier-Stokes flow.
operator: Omega1766 = T o B o R
equations: partial_t u + (u dot grad)u = -grad(p) + nu Delta u + F
Psi27D = candidate functional of the declared flow and explicit map to Sigma_1766
candidate bound: ||grad u||_infinity <= F_bound(Psi27D, initial_data, nu, boundary_data)
candidate continuation relation: bounded Psi27D -> integral_0^T ||omega(t)||_infinity dt < infinity
candidate energy control: dE_Omega/dt + nu D_Omega + gamma G_xi + gamma G_lambda <= C E_Omega

operator_roles.T: transport of the declared flow state
operator_roles.R: derived or measured response returned to the flow state
operator_roles.loop: state -> transport -> bridge -> response -> new state

assumptions: Sigma_1766 must be explicitly defined rather than inferred from its label.
Any E8-to-R^27 relation must be an explicit mathematical construction.
Psi27D must be dimensionally well-defined and invariant under the transformations claimed.
Omega1766 is a research operator mapping, not an additional Navier-Stokes axiom.
A bounded numerical trajectory is not a proof of global regularity.
UPI reduced rigid rotation is a control model, not a general 3D Navier-Stokes solver.
9 Hz and 21.6 degrees remain declared model/reference parameters, not universal Navier-Stokes constants.

mirror_operator.definition: M_Omega = (-Delta)^(-1) + Q_log + Q_xi + Q_lambda + Q_triangle + A_(21.6deg,9Hz)
mirror_operator.boundary: The proposed operator does not currently provide a proved global closure inequality.
verified_algebra: For isotropic divergence-preserving Fourier multipliers Q, <Q u, grad p> = 0 under the declared assumptions.
The nonlinear Q-energy term has exact commutator form.
Remaining cubic commutator residual scales as A^3 while quadratic energy and dissipation scale as A^2.

cross_model_review.purpose: Reduce correlated blind spots in symbolic derivation and verification.
cross_model_review.loop: SOURCE -> EXTRACT -> CLASSIFY -> DERIVE -> MIRROR -> COMPARE -> DELTA -> VERIFY -> LOOP
cross_model_review.rule: Independent agreement is not proof; disagreements and hidden assumptions must be surfaced and tested.
cross_model_review.relevance_to_hypothesis: Use an independent verifier to audit operator definitions, dimensions, invariance, estimates, and counterexamples.

null_model: Standard 3D incompressible Navier-Stokes evolution without the proposed Psi27D constraint or invariant.
control_condition: Compare null model, analytic smooth controls, manufactured solutions where available, resolution/time-step refinement, perturbations, Psi27D ablation, and independently generated trajectories.
confounders: Coordinate dependence of the proposed invariant
Overfitting of a candidate invariant to the control dataset
statistical_method: Predeclare metrics and compare Psi27D against ||omega||_infinity, ||grad u||_infinity and integral_0^T ||omega(t)||_infinity dt across independent trajectories.
replication_rule: Require independent reproduction on held-out trajectories before any status promotion.
test_method: Define Sigma_1766 and the E8-to-manifold map; verify dimensions and invariance; define T, B and R explicitly; compute Psi27D on independent Navier-Stokes trajectories; test quantitative bounds; run convergence, perturbation, null-model, ablation and adversarial counterexample tests.
predictions: If useful, Psi27D should exhibit reproducible bounded/invariant behavior across declared regular-flow controls.
A nontrivial quantitative relation between Psi27D and vorticity or gradient growth should survive resolution and time-step refinement.
The candidate control should add predictive information beyond standard diagnostics.
Any claimed Omega1766 closure should remain valid under independent re-derivation and should not depend on the verifier agreeing with the originating derivation.
falsification_conditions: No well-defined invariant can be constructed.
Dimensional consistency or claimed invariance fails.
The proposed global energy/gradient bound fails for an admissible flow.
Correlations disappear under controls or refinement.
A counterexample breaks the proposed bound.
The candidate reduces to an existing diagnostic without adding a new bound.
The result depends on a specific verifier or disappears under independent derivation.

evidence.notes: Research design only. No proof or experimental verification is claimed.

causal_test_method: Not applicable to the current non-causal hypothesis; the required test is mathematical/numerical falsification.
confusion_guard: Do not interpret the visual spiral, E8 analogy, frequency references, cross-model agreement or numerical PASS as evidence of a Navier-Stokes regularity theorem.
